title: DarkLock
description: Finally lock your enemies and mobs
body:
Estaba cansado de no encotrar un buen mod que hiciera lock a los mobs y decidi crearlo
tambien recomiendo usar Leawind's Third Person con este mod.

I was tired of not finding a good mod that would lock mobs, so I decided to create one
I also recommend using Leawind's Third Person with this mod.
